reviewer: showcase-gemini (bead m9r — IDNA domain validator bugfix)

spec_match.rationale: Directly invokes the browser's native URL parser to enforce IDNA2008 ContextJ rules (RFC 5892 Appendix A), accompanied by complete Virama and Dual/Right-joining cursive context analysis for Arabic and Persian scripts.

interactive.rationale: Text input with keyboard shortcuts, Validate and Clear buttons, and 10 clickable/keyboard-navigable sample domain buttons with full character inspection.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Concept lede matches the feature-index promise on key terms (characters, chrome, context, contextj, domain, enter, explains, internationalized, joining, name, passes, rules, unicode).

edge_cases.rationale: Covers both valid and invalid ZWJ and ZWNJ combinations across Devanagari Virama, Persian dual-joining, ASCII violations, punycode, and combining marks.

references.rationale: References section cites ChromeStatus, RFC 5891, RFC 5892 Appendix A, and Unicode TR31 ContextJ.

design_system.rationale: All buttons explicitly pair background and color. Valid, invalid, and edge badges and result panels provide WCAG AAA contrast (>7.8:1).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero horizontal overflow on 360x740 mobile viewport (scrollWidth === innerWidth === 360). All interactive buttons meet the 44px tap target guideline.

summary: Repaired IDNA domain validator (bead m9r): fixed 1:1 invisible text contrast by applying high-contrast AA/AAA color pairings (#064e3b on #e6f6ee, #881320 on #fdf0f0), fixed false rejection of valid joining domains (such as نامه‌ای.com) by supporting RFC 5892 dual-joining contexts matching the native URL constructor, eliminated mobile horizontal overflow (from 447px to 360px), and converted sample list rows into 44px accessible button controls.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible buttons with visible focus and 44px tap targets on touch devices
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic <button> elements with accessible names and minimum 44px tap targets for touch pointers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Sample list items converted from un-focusable div/li to full <button type=button class=sample-row> with descriptive aria-labels, 44px min-height, and visible focus outlines.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: chrome-devtools-mcp, Chrome 150: all 12 buttons have >=44px height and programmatic accessible names; 0 unnamed buttons.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible color contrast for status badges and alert panels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure foreground text against background meets at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 7:1 for enhanced contrast.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Replaced identical background/color rules with #e6f6ee/#064e3b (8.5:1) for valid and #fdf0f0/#881320 (7.8:1) for invalid panels and badges.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Computed contrast verified in Chrome DevTools: valid panel 8.5:1, invalid panel 7.8:1 (WCAG AAA).

guidanceConsulted.query: prevent horizontal overflow on mobile viewports with flex inputs
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use box-sizing: border-box, min-width: 0, word-break: break-all, and responsive flex-wrap / column layouts on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. Input row wraps or stacks on narrow viewports; domain text wraps; documentElement.scrollWidth === 360px at 360px viewport.
